mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month but SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 1% MoM but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply chain constraints and slowing economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline in late-cycle expansion does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer confidence and economic activity, consistently generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days through sustained corporate hiring and earnings growth.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline both occur but SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate increases above 4.5% elevate discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% in tightening cycle fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
